title: Add dark mode support
body: It would be great if the application supported a dark mode theme. I'd love to see a toggle in settings.

title: App crashes when uploading large files
body: Description: app crashes above 50MB. Steps to reproduce: open upload, choose large file, click upload, observe crash. Expected behavior: upload should succeed or show clear error.

title: Support CSV export for reports
body: Please add CSV export support in addition to PDF for easier analysis.

title: Login page is broken
body: The login page doesn't work. I can't log in. Please fix.

title: Search results are wrong after filtering
body: Bug report. Steps to reproduce: search invoices, apply last 7 days filter, stale results still show. Expected behavior: only last 7 days.
